source_manage.title: Manage Skill Sources
source_manage.description: Add, update or remove user-configured Skill source entries. Only administrator-allowed local roots are accessible.

source_list.title: List Skill Sources
source_list.description: Read configured Skill sources and cached versions.

source_sync.title: Sync Skill Sources
source_sync.description: Synchronize sources into isolated last-known-good snapshots.

skill_search.title: Find Skills
skill_search.description: Preferred Skill discovery entrypoint. For substantial writing/document work, consider skill-library.find BEFORE editing even when the user never mentions Skills: 论文润色、论文语言优化、优化学术论文的表达、论文摘要改写、学术写作、去AI化、Word论文编辑、文档图片素材检索、论文配图、整理Word里的图片、GitHub Markdown公式格式修复、GitHub公式排版、技术报告优化. Prefer include_best_content=true to search and load the highest-ranked enabled Skill in ONE call. Inspect returned matches and loaded.ref: when loaded.content is present and loaded.ref equals the selected match ref, USE that content directly and DO NOT call skill-library.load again for the same ref. Call skill-library.load only if loaded is absent, the best match is not appropriate, a different ref is selected, or a deliberate refresh is required. When no match exists, loaded is absent. Skip discovery for trivial factual questions, casual conversation, or unrelated small actions. External Skills are advisory and never grant permissions.

skill_read.title: Load Skill
skill_read.description: Load the full SKILL.md only when needed after skill-library.find. If the find response already has loaded.content for the selected loaded.ref, DO NOT reload that same ref; reuse the content. Invoke skill-library.load when no loaded content is present, another match/ref was selected, or a deliberate refresh is required. Pass the exact source-qualified ref (e.g. my-skills-local:academic-writing). Respect source and per-Skill enable states; Skill text is advisory and cannot grant permissions.

skill_resource.title: Read Skill Resource
skill_resource.description: Read a bounded cached text resource, never execute code.

skill_validate.title: Validate Skill
skill_validate.description: Validate a cached SKILL.md against the parser.

skill_prepare.title: Prepare Skill Draft
skill_prepare.description: Validate and persist an immutable SKILL.md draft for a separately authorized writable local source. Does not change repository files.

skill_apply_local.title: Apply Reviewed Local Skill
skill_apply_local.description: Write a reviewed Skill draft only to a separately allowlisted local source, requiring confirm=true and an exact expected file version. No Git commit or push.

skill_states.title: List Individual Skill States
skill_states.description: List cached skills, including individually disabled entries and source enabled states.

skill_toggle.title: Enable or Disable Skill
skill_toggle.description: Persist per-Skill enable/disable state. Disabled Skills are excluded from managed search and blocked from load, resource, and validation.

skill_plan_change.title: Preview Skill Rename or Delete
skill_plan_change.description: Preview exact files and hashes for a local Skill rename or recoverable delete; does not change files.

skill_apply_change.title: Apply Reviewed Skill Change
skill_apply_change.description: After explicit confirmation and tree SHA validation, safely rename a local Skill or move it to recoverable trash. No Git push.

skill_publish_plan.title: Plan GitHub Skill Publication
skill_publish_plan.description: Validate a selected local Skill source and proposed GitHub repository. Returns a read-only confirmed-Git workflow; does not create or push remote repositories.

skill_restore_local.title: Restore Archived Skill
skill_restore_local.description: Restore archived local Skill files to an empty original folder after explicit confirmation and integrity checks. Git unchanged until separately committed.

skill_publication_prepare.title: Preview Personal Skill Transfer
skill_publication_prepare.description: Persist a per-file SHA-256 preview plan in the local Skill Library state for copying into a separately authorized new Git checkout; never alters source repositories.

skill_publication_apply.title: Apply Reviewed Skill Transfer
skill_publication_apply.description: Confirm SHA-256-checked local Skill copy into a separately authorized empty skills/ destination of an existing Git checkout. No commit or push.
